resources.string: No DMs cached yet.\n\nTap here to check notification access, then wait for your next Instagram message.
This app puts your most recent Instagram DM previews on your home screen. Tapping the widget opens Instagram\'s direct message inbox.

It works by reading the DM notifications Instagram already posts to this phone, and caching the last few on the device. There is no login, no Instagram API, and no INTERNET permission — nothing is ever sent anywhere.
Instagram has no public deep link to an individual conversation, so tapping any row opens the general inbox rather than that specific thread.

Android 13 and newer block notification access for apps installed from an APK file instead of an app store. To clear it: open this app\'s info page, tap the three-dot menu in the top-right corner, and choose \"Allow restricted settings\". Then come back and grant notification access.

Add the widget with the button below. That asks your launcher to place it directly, which works even on launchers whose widget picker refuses to list third-party apps (Xiaomi\'s, notably). Long-pressing the home screen and choosing Widgets works too, where the picker lists it.
